授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 開発途上国の農村や農林水産業を取り巻く社会経済問題の現状と課題を総合的に捉え、それらに対処するための適切な理論的・実証的手法を学び、分析するための基礎的能力を身につけることを目的とする。具体的には、食糧問題や人口、経済成長、貧困、格差といったマクロ経済的な問題の現状と課題を総合的に捉え、その問題解決につながる制度やプロジェクトの効果(EFFECT)，課題要因，成功要因などを，行動経済学、実験経済学といったミクロ経済学的な理論的・実証的手法を学び，分析するための基礎的能力を身につける．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The objective of this course is to comprehensively understand the current status and issues of socioeconomic problems surrounding rural areas and agriculture, forestry, and fisheries in developing countries, and to acquire the basic skills to learn and analyze appropriate theoretical and empirical methods to deal with these problems. Specifically, the course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the current status and challenges of macroeconomic issues such as food problems, population, economic growth, poverty, and inequality, and to develop basic skills for learning and analyzing microeconomic theoretical and empirical methods such as behavioral economics and experimental economics to identify the effects of institutions and projects (Effect), problem factors, and success factors that lead to solutions to such issues. The course provides students with the basic skills to learn and analyze microeconomic theoretical and empirical methods such as behavioral economics and experimental economics.
